authority_scope: cross_field CLEAN role-local only; connector-schema classification does not itself authorize live writes outside the role-local repository namespace
classification_basis: Current connector action contracts exposed to this scheduled run plus the existing external-effect idempotency gate. No Gmail/Calendar mutation was executed.

classes.surface: GitHub Contents create_file in authorized role-local namespace
contract_facts: caller chooses stable repository path
create conflicts if path already exists
path can be fetched and content compared
classes.retry_recipe: Persist deterministic path/content. On ambiguous retry fetch path first; equal => DONE_NOOP, unequal => conflict. Never mint a second path for the same logical op.

classes.surface: GitHub Contents update_file/delete_file in authorized role-local namespace
contract_facts: update/delete require current blob SHA
stale SHA is rejected
current path is queryable
classes.retry_recipe: Fresh-fetch path; reconcile desired state; use observed blob SHA for one mutation; on conflict reconstruct and recompute rather than replay stale candidate.

contract_facts: connector states that if label already exists the existing label is returned instead of creating a duplicate
classes.retry_recipe: Reuse the identical label name; after ambiguity list/read labels and accept matching existing label. Role boundary still forbids this cross_field worker from live-testing it.

classes.surface: Gmail apply_labels_to_emails / batch_modify_email / archive_emails over frozen message IDs
contract_facts: inputs use stable Gmail message IDs
operations add/remove labels or remove INBOX membership
classes.retry_recipe: Freeze exact message IDs first. Reapply the same set-state mutation or read labels to reconcile. Do not infer exactly-once for unrelated notification/effect surfaces.

contract_facts: action re-runs a Gmail search query server-side on each invocation
classes.retry_recipe: For exact target replay, first materialize/freeze message IDs under a separately authorized workflow. Re-running the query can include newly matching messages and therefore is not the same logical target set.

contract_facts: connector accepts recipients/subject/body/attachments but exposes no caller-stable idempotency key or caller-chosen message identity
classes.retry_recipe: Do not claim exactly-once after an ambiguous send. Local op_id alone cannot distinguish not-sent from sent-with-lost-response.

contract_facts: connector accepts draft contents but no caller-chosen draft ID/idempotency token
classes.retry_recipe: A lost create response can make retry duplicate the draft. Treat exact-once creation as unresolved unless a reconciliation identity is added.

contract_facts: caller supplies existing draft_id
exposed contract does not state an idempotency guarantee for ambiguous repeated sends
classes.retry_recipe: Do not infer exactly-once merely from draft_id. Require an explicit post-send reconciliation theorem/contract before promotion.

contract_facts: connector create schema exposes event fields but no caller-supplied event_id or idempotency key
classes.retry_recipe: After an ambiguous create, title/time/search are not a guaranteed unique identity. Do not retry as exactly-once without a stable downstream key/identity.

contract_facts: event_id is stable and read_event exists
general update_event schema does not expose an ETag/precondition token
conference creation may be pending and requires reread
classes.retry_recipe: Reread event_id; if intended deterministic field state is already present, DONE_NOOP; otherwise update. Do not claim concurrent-writer linearizability or exactly-once attendee/notification side effects.

contract_facts: deletion addresses a stable event_id and read_event can query it
classes.retry_recipe: After ambiguity query the event ID; absent can be treated as desired final state, present can be deleted again under an authorized policy. Notification semantics are outside this state-only guarantee.

contract_facts: stable event_id and explicit desired response status are inputs
classes.retry_recipe: Reread attendee state before retry if authorized. Final response state may be reconciled; do not claim exactly-once notification delivery.

contract_facts: connector explicitly says already-correct events are returned unchanged
missing ETags/invalid IDs fail before write
concurrent updates are protected with current ETag
sendUpdates=none and only eventLabelId is changed
classes.retry_recipe: Read/resolve IDs; repeated desired label is no-op; use connector's ETag-protected mutation. This is the clearest non-repository candidate but remains outside this role's live-write boundary.

required: role write authority permits the surface
incremental monetary cost remains zero and no forbidden hosted/trial quota is introduced
effect is naturally idempotent, caller-keyed, or query-reconcilable under a stable identity
ambiguous retry has an explicit reconstruction/reconciliation recipe
scope distinguishes final-state convergence from exactly-once secondary notifications
promotion_gate.hard_reject: opaque create/send with no caller-stable idempotency key or reliable query identity

key_revision_from_v2: The matrix now distinguishes schema-observed retry semantics per current connector action instead of treating all external connectors as one unresolved class. Stable-ID state updates can be query-reconcilable without being CAS/notification-exact; caller-keyless sends/creates remain hard-gated.
next_action: If role authority ever permits a non-repository live validation, prefer the strongest schema candidate (an already-correct/no-op + ETag-protected stable-ID update) rather than an opaque create/send. Until then, keep live mutation tests inside the role-local GitHub namespace.
